faqs.question: How do I join the EpistleChat waitlist?
faqs.answer: Head to the [EpistleChat page](epistlechat.html#join), enter your email and pick your device. That's it. We'll email you when it's ready to pre-download.

faqs.question: When will I hear from you?
faqs.answer: We'll only email you when there's real news: when pre-download opens on the App Store, and on launch day. No newsletters you didn't ask for.

faqs.question: How do I leave the waitlist?
faqs.answer: Every email we send has an unsubscribe link. You can also email support@silentstudios.online and we'll remove you right away.

faqs.question: What is EpistleChat?
faqs.answer: EpistleChat is an end-to-end encrypted messenger for iPhone: private chats and beautiful letters. Write real letters delivered as a classic letter, royal scroll, message in a bottle, paper plane, time capsule or museum exhibit, and chat, call and hang out in communities in the same app.

faqs.question: Which devices will EpistleChat support?
faqs.answer: EpistleChat launches first on iOS through the App Store, with Android coming later. Pick Android when you join the waitlist and we'll email you the moment it's ready.

faqs.question: Will EpistleChat be free?
faqs.answer: Yes. EpistleChat is free. Optional memberships unlock extra cosmetics and bigger limits.

faqs.question: What do you do with my email?
faqs.answer: We use it only to tell you about EpistleChat's availability. We never sell or share it with advertisers.

faqs.question: Is my data private?
faqs.answer: Yes. Messages, photos, voice notes and files are end-to-end encrypted, and your encryption keys stay on your device. There's also Face ID lock, two-factor sign-in, screenshot alerts and safer defaults for teen accounts. No ads, and your data is never sold.

faqs.question: What is Kraylus?
faqs.answer: Kraylus is our next app: a finance app for sending and receiving money, managing digital assets, and taking payments in person with a point of sale for your business. It's still in the concept stage and development hasn't started yet. Follow along on the [Kraylus page](kraylus.html).

faqs.question: How do I contact Silent Studios Entertainment?
faqs.answer: Use the [contact form](index.html#contact) or email support@silentstudios.online. We usually reply within two working days.
